The '''Lifesaver Emergency Battery''' was a reserve [[Battery/Legends|battery]] manufactured by [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. Marketed as a fail-safe for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems, the battery provided an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] of extra power in the event of a power failure.<ref name="PP" />
